# Disagreement Log — GTH_060

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 60
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 60 | "That one around the lamb" (elliptical) | "Why does that man carry the lamb?" | "What do you think that man will do with the lamb?" | Expansion of the elliptical Coptic opening |
| 2 | 60 | "kill it" | "slaughter it" | "kill it" | *hotpt*: ritual slaughter vs. generic killing |
| 3 | 60 | "corpse" | "corpse" | "carcass" | Animal dead body: corpse vs. carcass |
| 4 | 60 | "a place for rest" | "a place of rest" | "a resting-place" | *anapausis*: compound vs. separate |
| 5 | 60 | "lest you become" | "lest you become" | "before you become" | Warning clause temporal framing |

**Total disagreements: 5**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "slaughter" (LOGOS), "corpse" for human application, "place of rest" (formal), and "lest" for the warning.
